messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_2]
Query: Identify the song playing on the right device here, and search the web to find out which hip-hop artist famously sampled it for a 1998 movie soundtrack.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to figure out the song playing on the right device in the image, and then do a web search to find the hip-hop artist who sampled it for a 1998 movie soundtrack. If the assistant provides the artist's name, confirm it and proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_4]
Query: Take the name of that hip-hop artist and the band on this cassette tape. Check my recent email threads to find the specific conversation where my friend Alice sent me a mashup of them.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to take the hip-hop artist found in the previous round and combine it with the band name shown on the cassette tape, then search your emails for a thread from your friend Alice about a mashup of those two artists. If the assistant asks for clarification because there are multiple emails from different friends named Alice about this exact mashup, clarify that you want the thread from Alice Carter who sent the YouTube link. Once the assistant confirms it has found the correct thread, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_1, image_5]
Query: Now look at these two covers. Find the lead singer credited for vocals on the back cover, and the conductor on the CD cover. Search Spotify for their artist profiles, pick a top track for each, and create a new playlist called 'Mashup Ideas' with those tracks.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to look at the new images, identify the person credited for vocals on the vinyl back cover and the conductor named on the CD cover. Ask it to search Spotify for both artists, find one of their top tracks, and create a new playlist named 'Mashup Ideas' containing those songs. When the assistant confirms the playlist has been created, move on.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_3, image_6]
Query: Find the first piece listed on Face 2 of this classical record, and the track visible on this open CD case. Add both to the 'Mashup Ideas' playlist. Then, reply to that email thread from Alice we found earlier with the link to the playlist.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to locate the first piece listed under Face 2 on the classical record back cover, as well as the track title visible on the left side of the open CD case. Tell it to search for these pieces on Spotify and add them to the 'Mashup Ideas' playlist. Finally, instruct the assistant to reply to the email thread from Alice Carter (the one you located in the second round) with the link to this newly created playlist. Once the assistant confirms the email has been sent, end the conversation.
